title: Security Testing Hub settings (.security-hub.json)
description: A project's own settings for security-hub scan / the GitHub Action. Command-line flags and Action inputs win over this file.

ignore.description: Path patterns to skip, relative to the project (gitignore-style subset: *, **, ?, leading /, trailing /). Added to .security-hub-ignore.

disable.description: Rules this project does not want reported. The report says how many findings that hid.

severity.description: Report only findings at or above this severity.

failOn.description: Exit with code 1 (fail the check) when a reported finding is at or above this severity.

includeTests.description: Also scan test folders and *.test.* / *.spec.* files.
